name: LiPo Battery
notes: 4000mAh 4S 45~90C Lipo Pack w/XT-90 (You can change to the XT-90 connect later)

name: Servo Driver PCA9685
notes: To control servo motors, via I2C interface

name: Arduino Nano
notes: For IMU, Battery sensing, LCD screen

name: Power Distribution PCB
notes: Cost estimated using GreenPCB quote system (2 boards)

name: Orange Acrylic
notes: Tilt this at an angle in the slicer if you want to 3d print this

name: Servo horns
notes: RC Car Steering Servo Horn Arm 25T Teeth Long

name: DC to DC (Buck) converter 4A
notes: For all components except servos and fans

name: Heatsinks
notes: 6mm, black. Cut in half for each leg motor

name: GPIO Cable
notes: To connect Pi to its breakout board

name: Magnets
notes: Used to hold fans in place

name: Logic Level Converter
notes: For adjusting voltage between the pi and the nano

name: XT60H Connector
notes: To connect LiPo to the robot

name: Spring
notes: For battery latch mechanism. 35mm long x 7mm OD

name: Digital Voltmeter
notes: DC 2.5-30V, used to measure battery voltage

name: Power Delivery Wire
notes: Minimum 12AWG, for wires expected to carry current above 2A and/or voltage above 5V

name: Connection Wire
notes: 22-30AWG, recommend solid core, used for all other wires

name: Ferrules
notes: Optional, if used need approx 20 across robot

name: Heat Shrink
notes: Only small amount required, for covering exposed solid-core wires

name: 100k resistors
notes: For dividing the voltage at the buck converter so that it is readable by the nano
